71720.subject: Chemistry
71720.text: What is the role of aspirin?
71720.sol: Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) belongs to the class of drugs known as non-narcotic analgesics. It also has antipyretic (fever-reducing) properties. Thus, the primary role of aspirin is as an analgesic. Answer: Analgesics

The blood will tend to flow back into the left atrium
The flow of blood into the pulmonary artery will be reduced
84135.sol: Strong, thread-like tendons, called chordae tendinae, arise from papillary muscles and insert upon the flaps of tricuspid and bicuspid valves.
